objective: medium-term cross-coin spread and relative-return convergence; no promised profit
precedence: Preserve existing stricter frozen constraints; stop and report any conflict before running returns. Synthetic thresholds are not evidence of real qualification.

hypotheses.primary: lagged log-price residual mean reversion with point-in-time qualified pair or basket
hypotheses.secondary: relative-return residual mean reversion, separately reported and budgeted
hypotheses.qualification: Retain frozen EG/ADF/stability methods, complete-family binding and point-in-time eligibility. Never promote synthetic permits to real permits. Selection uses training/validation only.

calendar.original_locked_test_status: integrity_unverified; must not call untouched until independent exposure audit
calendar.known_exposure: M1 data quality and eligibility audits, legacy preflights with uncertain counts, once-recorded missing-mark integration, and disclosed cached audit; no claim of clean OOS follows from absence of NAV alone
calendar.quarantine_policy: 79-day funding integration window is diagnostic only, excluded from confirmatory scoring and parameter selection
calendar.test_integrity_gate: Before any strategy return calculation, independently inventory all prior exposures and declare exact eligible test dates. Exposed dates stay labelled exposed. No performance-based exclusions or relabelling. If fewer than 365 eligible daily test observations remain, final acceptance is unavailable.
calendar.future_reserve_policy: Unobserved prospective reserve at registration; not available evidence today. No shortening or reuse for tuning. Engineering and explicitly labelled exploration may continue while it accrues.
calendar.warmup: 180-day verified listing age plus required lagged liquidity and model warmup; no zero-fill; purge overlapping positions at train/validation/test boundaries and account for actual closing costs; no fabricated terminal fills

costs.funding: actual historical signed settlements at historical settlement marks and actual cadence; missing rates or marks refuse costed acceptance; current WS snapshots never become settlement cashflow
costs.fee_history: Public Lv1 constant-rate scenario, not verified historical account fees; report regional/instrument exceptions separately
costs.borrow: no spot borrowing; any later borrowing requires actual rates and new preregistration
costs.slippage_accounting: embedded in execution prices exactly once
costs.capacity: For declared 10000-USDT research capital, per-symbol daily traded notional <=0.001 times preceding 30 complete days mean USDT quote turnover. This is a participation screen, not proof of executable capacity; insufficient venue constraints or market-depth evidence keeps capacity conclusion unavailable.

baselines.btc: BTC spot buy-and-hold with buy/sell costs, no invented perpetual funding
baselines.equal_weight: point-in-time eligible mainstream-coin spot equal-weight, weekly rebalance, same availability and cost conventions; unavailable spot prices must be reported, never substituted silently
baselines.cash: zero-return USDT cash reference; depeg and custody risk outside this ledger
baselines.comparison: Common dates and declared capital, no leverage rescaling after results; report net CAGR, drawdown, Sharpe and Calmar for each. Primary relative-value acceptance requires positive active return against cash and Sharpe >= both BTC and equal-weight. Report absolute return differences even when negative.

confirmatory_gates.sharpe_definition: daily equity returns, 365 calendar-day annualization, zero cash reference; include no-trade days; zero variance is undefined and fails
confirmatory_gates.cagr_definition: elapsed actual calendar time; cannot annualize a short capture as research acceptance
confirmatory_gates.calmar_definition: net CAGR divided by positive maximum drawdown; undefined metrics cannot silently pass
confirmatory_gates.robustness: At least 3 of 4 prespecified primary neighbours have positive costed validation CAGR; no neighbour is selected using test. Report daily/monthly block-bootstrap uncertainty, all failures, turnover, exposure, pair attribution, downside and censoring. Do not call confidence established solely because a point estimate passes.
confirmatory_gates.gate_rationale: 8% is an explicit research hurdle for low-leverage capital use, not a forecast; Sharpe 1 and Calmar .75 require risk-adjusted return; 15% drawdown follows the earlier 15% volatility budget as a separate cap; doubled costs test fragility; a full year and 30 completed books limit short-sample claims. All gates are conjunctive, cannot be lowered after results.

configurations: primary: window56 entry2 exit0.5 break4 timeout28 weekly
neighbour: window28; all other primary parameters unchanged
neighbour: window112; all other primary parameters unchanged
neighbour: entry1.5; all other primary parameters unchanged
neighbour: entry2.5; all other primary parameters unchanged
secondary: relative-return residual; exact construction must be source-frozen and independently reviewed before any return computation
experiment_budget.confirmation: Only one training/validation-selected configuration may consume eligible held-out test once. Deterministic verification of frozen output is not a new experiment; inspecting new configurations on test is forbidden.
experiment_budget.selection: Across qualified complete families on training, select highest validation net Sharpe among configurations passing data, risk, positive validation return and required neighbour robustness; ties choose lower turnover then primary. Secondary cannot substitute for failed primary robustness.
experiment_budget.multiple_testing: Holm FWER .05 across the full declared candidate-by-configuration hypothesis family, retain BY FDR comparison only; preserve every tested and unavailable member and test statistic. Do not count only survivors.
experiment_budget.failure_policy: Persist all failed and rejected runs. After this budget, preregister a reasoned new hypothesis/version using only permissible exploration data; consumed held-out test never becomes clean again. No endless rerun on a fixed test set.
experiment_budget.preexecution_gate: Commit and hash exact strategy definitions, eligible date lists, cost calendar, dependency lock, data manifests, limits and selection algorithm; independent preregistration review before calculating new strategy returns. Any ambiguity is resolved and frozen before returns, never after.

first_milestone: bounded official public-data coverage probe plus resumable downloader and machine-readable gaps; synthetic experiment wiring and preregistration review can proceed without market data
scope: offline research only; no private credentials, real orders, automatic demo trading, production changes, data purchases, denied-path bypass or public controlled-data release
